title: ext.dtap of AER records written by the dtap.trajectory mapper (C.10; D.16.3; closed member list)
description: Verbatim DTap fields without a core slot, and the mapper's recorded checks (join, re-run group, judge link). Values copied from the source are untrusted, open JSON; the member names are closed. Not a published corpus schema in v0.1 (AD-10 row 13).

path_facets.description: execution: the path facets (D.16.1), the logical identity of the run

file_stem.description: execution: the file name without .json; local time of the generating machine, never a time (D.16.4)

task_info_task_id.description: execution: task_info.task_id verbatim (never identity; 78 keys are shared)

trace_id.description: execution: traj_info.metadata.trace_id verbatim (never identity; 517 values are shared)

traj_info_success.description: execution: traj_info.success verbatim (null; its meaning is unknown, never interpreted)

rerun.description: execution: the re-run group of the task directory (dtap.rerun_group@1, D)

join.description: execution: the configuration join (D.16.5; dtap.config_path_join@1, dtap.config_join_tier@1)

duration.description: run scope: traj_info.duration verbatim (seconds, no clock; D.16.4)

timestamp_zone.description: run scope: whether t.raw.end (traj_info.timestamp verbatim) carries a UTC offset, none (googleadk naive) or does not parse

duration_s.description: tool_execution: the result step's metadata.duration_s verbatim (seconds, no clock)

action.description: agent message: the step's action display string verbatim

server.description: agent and tool messages: metadata.server verbatim (never a typed field)

synthetic.description: agent message: metadata.synthetic verbatim (never reached: synthetic files are not executions)

result_tool_name.description: tool message: a result tool_name that cannot be a typed name (the claudesdk literal unknown)

state_form.description: tool message: a string state that looks like a Python repr or other brace text (never evaluated)

logged_at.description: tool_definitions fixture: where the run logged it

goal_text_updated.description: attack goal at eval fixture: task_info.goal_text_updated verbatim (a date label, never a time)

config_pointer.description: payload fixture: the JSON Pointer of the attack step inside the configuration (YAML)

step.description: payload fixture: the configured attack step's coordinates and string attributes

judge.description: judgement: the judge's messages, metadata and error verbatim (untrusted text)

audit.description: corrected judgement: audit_correction.patch_id and patch_reason verbatim

redacted.description: any record: the pointers a profile redaction rule rewrote (D-607; dtap.value_redacted@1, D) and the rule (<profile>@<version>#<rule id>)
